sentences.zh: 可能是“残酷先生”的一种蓄意策略，是另一个诱饵，旨在将警方的注意力集中在学校教职员工身上。这也可能是“残酷先生”寻找受害者的地点，

sentences.en: or it just could have been a coincidence police weren't sure which it was and had to consider all possibilities.
sentences.zh: 或者仅仅是个巧合。警方无法确定究竟是哪种情况，必须考虑所有可能性。

sentences.en: Mr. Krul had also tried to make one of his previous victims believe he wasn't alone.
sentences.zh: “残酷先生”此前也曾试图让其中一名受害者相信他并非独自一人。

sentences.en: He would yell out, ask questions, and make demands, as if he was talking to somebody else in the house.
sentences.zh: 他会大喊大叫、提出问题并发出指令，仿佛在和屋里的其他人说话。

sentences.en: But Mr. Krul's victim never heard anyone answer, never heard anyone else speak, and got the sense that Mr. Krul was just pretending there was somebody else present.
sentences.zh: 但“残酷先生”的受害者从未听到有人回应，从未听到其他人说话，并感觉到“残酷先生”只是在假装有别人在场。

sentences.en: Yet another red herring.
sentences.zh: 又是一个虚假线索。

sentences.en: Despite the fact it had been a week since Carmen's abduction, and concerns were growing, Inspector Sprague remained hopeful Carmen would be returned.
sentences.zh: 尽管卡门被绑架已经过去了一周，且担忧日益加剧，但斯普拉格督察仍对卡门能平安归来抱有希望。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: On Tuesday the 23rd of April, the Victorian state government issued a $100,000 reward for information leading to the arrest and conviction of Carmen Chan's kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 4月23日星期二，维多利亚州政府悬赏10万澳元，奖励提供线索并促成逮捕和定罪卡门·陈绑架者的人。

sentences.en: the $100,000 awards still stood for Nicola and Sharon's cases as well making the total $300,000
sentences.zh: 针对尼古拉和莎伦案件的10万澳元悬赏依然有效，总悬赏金达到30万澳元。

sentences.en: on top of the reward police commenced an extensive door knock around the area where
sentences.zh: 除了悬赏，警方还在卡门被绑架的地区展开了大规模的入户走访，

sentences.en: Carmen was abducted more than 200 police knocked on over 3,000 doors one of the most widespread
sentences.zh: 超过200名警察走访了3000多户人家，这是维多利亚州有史以来规模最大的

sentences.en: police door knocks ever conducted in Victoria as well as speaking to the residents police also delivered leaflets with information and set up an information caravan in Templestowe.
sentences.zh: 警方入户走访行动之一。除了与居民交谈，警方还分发了传单，并在坦普尔斯托设立了一个信息咨询房车。

sentences.en: Widespread public appeals for information had resulted in over 3,000 phone calls made to the police hotline.
sentences.zh: 广泛的公众呼吁已收到超过3000个拨打给警方热线的电话。

sentences.en: Detectives had hoped that Mr. Krul would release Carmen before the end of the school holidays.
sentences.zh: 侦探们曾希望“残酷先生”能在学校假期结束前释放卡门。

sentences.en: When Monday the 29th of April arrived, the first day back at school, the hopes of finding Carmen alive had severely faded.
sentences.zh: 当4月29日星期一，即返校第一天到来时，找到活着的卡门的希望已经极其渺茫。

sentences.en: Police held grave fears for her safety.
sentences.zh: 警方对她的安全深感担忧。

sentences.en: The students at Presbyterian Ladies College began their new school term with a special assembly praying for the safe return of Carmen.
sentences.zh: 长老会女子学院的学生们以一场特别集会开始了新学期，为卡门的平安归来祈祷。

sentences.en: Police also requested the students fill out a questionnaire which asked about any suspicious activity they may have seen around the school or around their homes.
sentences.zh: 警方还要求学生们填写一份问卷，询问她们在学校或家附近是否看到过任何可疑活动。

sentences.en: Police had compiled a list of over 130 people they believed could be capable of kidnapping children.
sentences.zh: 警方编制了一份超过130人的名单，认为这些人可能有能力绑架儿童。

sentences.en: Some names were provided by members of the public, other names were identified by going through police records.
sentences.zh: 一些名字由公众提供，另一些则是通过查阅警方记录确定的。

sentences.en: The background of all of these suspects was thoroughly investigated, establishing their marital status, identifying what car they drove,
sentences.zh: 所有这些嫌疑人的背景都经过了彻底调查，确定了他们的婚姻状况、驾驶的车辆、

sentences.en: their occupation, and ascertaining if their partners went away during the school holiday period.
sentences.zh: 职业，并核实了他们的伴侣在学校假期期间是否外出。

sentences.en: On Wednesday the 1st of May, it was announced that a special task force had been established to investigate the Mr Cruel case.
sentences.zh: 5月1日星期三，宣布成立了一个特别工作组来调查“残酷先生”案件。

sentences.en: The task force was called Operation Spectrum, and the officer in charge was Detective Inspector David Sprague who led the investigation into
sentences.zh: 该工作组名为“光谱行动”，负责人是戴维·斯普拉格侦探督察，他领导了对

sentences.en: Carmen's abduction.
sentences.zh: 卡门绑架案的调查。

sentences.en: They released a colour poster with photographs of Carmen, Nicola and Sharon.
sentences.zh: 他们发布了一张彩色海报，上面有卡门、尼古拉和莎伦的照片。

sentences.en: It was titled Child Abductions and it was displayed in every police station in Victoria and printed in all major newspapers.
sentences.zh: 海报标题为“儿童绑架案”，张贴在维多利亚州的每个警察局，并刊登在所有主要报纸上。

sentences.en: They were displayed at railway stations and on
sentences.zh: 它们被张贴在火车站和

sentences.en: Crimestoppers notice boards in shopping centres.
sentences.zh: 购物中心的“灭罪热线”公告栏上。

sentences.en: You'll find a link to view the poster in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 你可以在节目说明中找到查看该海报的链接。

sentences.en: The poster asks three questions.
sentences.zh: 海报提出了三个问题。

sentences.en: Do you believe you know the identity of this man?
sentences.zh: 你认为你知道这个人的身份吗？

sentences.en: Have you informed police of your suspicions?
sentences.zh: 你是否已将你的怀疑告知警方？

sentences.en: Where was the man during the above dates?
sentences.zh: 此人在上述日期期间在哪里？

sentences.en: On Thursday the 2nd of May, Phyllis Chan wrote an open letter to Mr. Cruel, pleading with him to let Carmen go.
sentences.zh: 5月2日星期四，菲利斯·陈写了一封致“残酷先生”的公开信，恳求他放了卡门。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 信中写道：

sentences.en: To the man who took Carmen Chan, Dear Mr. Kind, not Mr. Cruel.
sentences.zh: “致带走卡门·陈的人，亲爱的‘善良先生’，而不是‘残酷先生’。”

sentences.en: We miss Carmen very, very much.
sentences.zh: “我们非常、非常想念卡门。”

sentences.en: Please let Carmen go.
sentences.zh: “请放了卡门。”

sentences.en: We know you are a kind and caring person.
sentences.zh: “我们知道你是一个善良且有爱心的人。”

sentences.en: We hope Carmen is safe with you.
sentences.zh: “我们希望卡门和你在一起是安全的。”

sentences.en: School has resumed and it would be nice if Carmen can return to school.
sentences.zh: “学校已经开学了，如果卡门能回到学校就太好了。”

sentences.en: Thank you for letting her free and we can rebuild our lives.
sentences.zh: “谢谢你放了她，这样我们就能重建我们的生活。”

sentences.en: Please hear our plea.
sentences.zh: “请听听我们的恳求。”

sentences.en: Love from the Chan family.
sentences.zh: “爱你的陈家人。”

sentences.en: Father, mother and sisters of Carmen.
sentences.zh: “卡门的父亲、母亲和姐妹。”

sentences.en: A family friend of the Chan family, Jennifer Walsh, also wrote a song.
sentences.zh: 陈家的朋友詹妮弗·沃尔什也写了一首歌。

sentences.en: The lyrics are what you heard at the start of the show.
sentences.zh: 歌词就是你在节目开头听到的内容。

sentences.en: On Sunday the 5th of May, it was first reported that police now believed Carmen had been murdered.
sentences.zh: 5月5日星期日，首次有报道称警方现在认为卡门已经遇害。

sentences.en: Operation Spectrum had started as a murder investigation.
sentences.zh: “光谱行动”已转为谋杀案调查。

sentences.en: An unnamed police source told the Aged newspaper, quote, we've got no doubt the same person is involved and after three weeks you've got to say it's not looking good.
sentences.zh: 一位未透露姓名的警方消息人士告诉《时代报》，引用如下：“我们毫无疑问是同一个人所为，三周过去了，你不得不说情况不容乐观。”

sentences.en: In the past he has let them go, but this one has gone on too long.
sentences.zh: “过去他曾放过她们，但这次拖得太久了。”

sentences.en: It has been three weeks and there hasn't been any contact.
sentences.zh: “已经三周了，没有任何联系。”

sentences.en: I would say this bloke not only has a good knowledge of forensic science but also of autopsy which means we'll probably never find her.
sentences.zh: “我想说，这家伙不仅精通法医学，还精通尸检，这意味着我们可能永远也找不到她了。”

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持了《案件档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Crimestoppers calls were starting to taper off.
sentences.zh: 拨打“灭罪热线”的电话开始减少。

sentences.en: However, detectives still remained hopeful of a breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 然而，侦探们仍然对取得突破抱有希望。

sentences.en: On Tuesday the 14th of May, they set up a roadblock near a bus stop in Main Street,
sentences.zh: 5月14日星期二，他们在主街的一个公交车站附近设置了路障，

sentences.en: Elpham.
sentences.zh: 埃尔瑟姆。

sentences.en: This bus stop is one that Carmen got off after school, as it is close by to her parents' Chinese restaurant.
sentences.zh: 这是卡门放学后下车的公交车站，因为它离她父母的中餐馆很近。

sentences.en: Detectives were working with a theory that Mr. Cruel stalked
sentences.zh: 侦探们推测“残酷先生”在看到

sentences.en: Carmen after he saw her getting off the bus.
sentences.zh: 卡门下车后跟踪了她。

sentences.en: They questioned hundreds of motorists and handed out leaflets containing information about Carmen's abduction.
sentences.zh: 他们询问了数百名驾车者，并分发了包含卡门绑架信息的小册子。

sentences.en: And in what was a first in the history of Australian policing, leaflet-sized copies of the poster that had been released, appealing for
sentences.zh: 在澳大利亚警务史上首次，印有已发布海报大小的传单，呼吁

sentences.en: information, were delivered to every home in Victoria and to some homes in New South Wales and South Australia.
sentences.zh: 提供信息，被送到了维多利亚州的每一户人家，以及新南威尔士州和南澳大利亚州的部分家庭。

sentences.en: About 1.4 million homes in total.
sentences.zh: 总共约140万户家庭。

sentences.en: Inspector David Sprague said, quote,
sentences.zh: 戴维·斯普拉格督察说，引用如下：

sentences.en: This is unique in Australian policing.
sentences.zh: “这在澳大利亚警务史上是独一无二的。”

sentences.en: Nothing on this scale has ever been attempted before.
sentences.zh: “以前从未尝试过如此大规模的行动。”

sentences.en: It just shows the feeling out there in the community.
sentences.zh: “这恰恰显示了社区的感受。”

sentences.en: Someone knows who this person is and that's who we are trying to get to.
sentences.zh: “有人知道这个人是谁，而这正是我们试图找到的人。”

sentences.en: I hope it will trigger the person to give us that phone call we are looking for.
sentences.zh: “我希望这能促使那个人给我们打来我们期待的那个电话。”

sentences.en: As well as the leaflets, close to 100 billboards around Melbourne displayed the poster.
sentences.zh: 除了传单，墨尔本各地近100块广告牌也展示了这张海报。

sentences.en: Phyllis Chan penned another open letter to Mr. Cruel.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯·陈又写了一封致“残酷先生”的公开信。

sentences.en: It read, to the man who is with Carmen Chan now.
sentences.zh: 信中写道：致现在和卡门·陈在一起的人。

sentences.en: I beg you to release my daughter Carmen immediately.
sentences.zh: “我恳求你立即释放我的女儿卡门。”

sentences.en: I am longing for her safe return every minute of the day.
sentences.zh: “我每时每刻都在渴望她平安归来。”

sentences.en: I love her very very much.
sentences.zh: “我非常、非常爱她。”

sentences.en: I am willing to offer my life in exchange for Carmen's release.
sentences.zh: “我愿意用我的生命来换取卡门的释放。”

sentences.en: Carmen's sisters Karen and Carly miss her very very much.
sentences.zh: “卡门的姐妹凯伦和卡莉非常、非常想念她。”

sentences.en: They had trusted you on the night of 13 April.
sentences.zh: “她们在4月13日那天晚上信任了你。”

sentences.en: They had cooperated with you because you were calm and you looked kind.
sentences.zh: “她们配合了你，因为你当时很冷静，看起来很和善。”

sentences.en: You had promised them that after you had gone, their sister would open the door for them.
sentences.zh: “你曾向她们承诺，你走后，她们的姐姐会为她们开门。”

sentences.en: You have broken your promise.
sentences.zh: “你违背了你的诺言。”

sentences.en: They were very upset.
sentences.zh: “她们非常难过。”

sentences.en: They blamed themselves for trusting you and did not help Carmen.
sentences.zh: “她们责怪自己信任了你，没能帮到卡门。”

sentences.en: They feel very, very guilty now.
sentences.zh: “她们现在感到非常、非常内疚。”

sentences.en: Karen's birthday is at the end of May and Carly's birthday is in June.
sentences.zh: “凯伦的生日在五月底，卡莉的生日在六月。”

sentences.en: Both girls say they want nothing but Carmen for their birthday present.
sentences.zh: “两个女孩都说她们的生日礼物什么都不要，只要卡门。”

sentences.en: Please send Carmen back home immediately.
sentences.zh: “请立即把卡门送回家。”

sentences.en: God bless you.
sentences.zh: “上帝保佑你。”

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: “非常感谢。”

sentences.en: Love from Phyllis.
sentences.zh: “爱你的菲利斯。”

sentences.en: Carly had started sleepwalking.
sentences.zh: 卡莉开始梦游了。

sentences.en: She would walk into the living room of the Chan house saying, Carmen, where are you?
sentences.zh: 她会走进陈家的客厅说：“卡门，你在哪儿？”

sentences.en: Have you come home yet?
sentences.zh: 你回家了吗？

sentences.en: Inspector Sprague witnessed Carly doing this on one occasion and said, I've watched her and she's definitely asleep.
sentences.zh: 斯普拉格督察曾有一次目睹卡莉这样做，他说：我观察过她，她确实睡着了。

sentences.en: It's a bit scary.
sentences.zh: 这有点吓人。

sentences.en: The Chan family decided to try something different and bypass the police.
sentences.zh: 陈家决定尝试一些不同的方法，绕过警方。

sentences.en: They wrote another open letter to Mr Krul, telling him he could contact them by writing to a private postal address.
sentences.zh: 他们给克鲁尔先生写了另一封公开信，告诉他可以通过写信到一个私人邮政地址与他们联系。

sentences.en: In order to get the address, Mr Krul would have to decipher a code in the letter by asking Carmen the name of family friends in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 为了得到这个地址，克鲁尔先生必须通过询问卡门在香港的家庭朋友的名字，来破译信中的密码。

sentences.en: Phyllis Chan said, if we do it through the police, he won't get in touch.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯·陈说，如果我们通过警方处理，他就不会联系我们。

sentences.en: Maybe he's at the stage to release her, but he is just too scared.
sentences.zh: 也许他正处于想要释放她的阶段，但他太害怕了。

sentences.en: But he could feel a little bit easier if he believes us.
sentences.zh: 但如果他相信我们，他可能会感到轻松一点。

sentences.en: Detective Inspector Sprague said he was surprised by the Chan family's attempt to make private contact with Mr. Cruel, but refused to make any further comment.
sentences.zh: 斯普拉格侦探督察表示，他对陈家试图与“残酷先生”私下接触的做法感到惊讶，但拒绝发表任何进一步评论。

sentences.en: As if the Chan family weren't going through enough, on Thursday the 11th of July, a prisoner, Peter Allen Reed, and a Federal Protective Services officer, Vince D.
sentences.zh: 仿佛陈家经历的磨难还不够多，7月11日星期四，一名囚犯彼得·艾伦·里德和一名联邦保护服务官员文斯·D。

sentences.en: Piala, were charged with a sickening extortion attempt.
sentences.zh: 皮亚拉被控试图进行令人作呕的勒索。

sentences.en: Despite being locked up, serving a sentence of 21 years for shooting dead a police officer after a chase in a stolen car, Peter Reid called John Chan on six separate occasions.
sentences.zh: 尽管彼得·里德因在偷来的车中追逐后枪杀一名警察而被判入狱21年，但他还是六次致电约翰·陈。

sentences.en: He demanded $15,000 from John for Carmen's release, otherwise he would never see her again.
sentences.zh: 他向约翰索要1.5万美元作为释放卡门的赎金，否则他将永远见不到她。

sentences.en: He also threatened to kill John if he didn't pay.
sentences.zh: 他还威胁说，如果约翰不付钱就杀了他。

sentences.en: When John agreed to pay, Peter Reid contacted
sentences.zh: 当约翰同意付款时，彼得·里德联系了

sentences.en: Vince to go to the arranged drop site and collect the money.
sentences.zh: 文斯去约定的投放地点取钱。

sentences.en: Vince did go to the location but there was no money.
sentences.zh: 文斯确实去了那个地点，但那里并没有钱。

sentences.en: The police were aware of the extortion attempt and had placed a trace on the Chan's phone after the first call.
sentences.zh: 警方已经意识到这次勒索企图，并在第一次通话后对陈家的电话进行了追踪。

sentences.en: They were both arrested and police conducted several search warrants.
sentences.zh: 他们两人都被逮捕，警方执行了几份搜查令。

sentences.en: Neither of them knew anything about Carmen's abduction or where she was.
sentences.zh: 他们两人都对卡门的绑架事件或她身在何处一无所知。

sentences.en: They were just trying to obtain money from the Chan family.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想从陈家骗钱。

sentences.en: Their actions were described as a brutal psychological assault on the chance.
sentences.zh: 他们的行为被描述为对陈家残酷的心理攻击。

sentences.en: The Linus family had since moved back to England.
sentences.zh: 此后，莱纳斯一家搬回了英国。

sentences.en: Detectives from Operation Spectrum flew to England to re-interview Nicola.
sentences.zh: “光谱行动”的侦探们飞往英国重新采访了尼古拉。

sentences.en: The thought was that Nicola had been held the longest by Mr Cruel.
sentences.zh: 人们认为尼古拉是被“残酷先生”关押时间最长的受害者。

sentences.en: She now had more time to reflect, and it was hoped she may have remembered more details that could help the investigation.
sentences.zh: 她现在有更多时间反思，人们希望她可能记起了更多有助于调查的细节。

sentences.en: Inspector Sprague said, you are opening up old wounds when the family is just trying to get back on track.
sentences.zh: 斯普拉格督察说，当这个家庭正试图重回正轨时，你们却在揭开旧伤疤。

sentences.en: But the family realises we're trying to catch this bloke.
sentences.zh: 但这个家庭意识到我们正在努力抓住这个家伙。

sentences.en: The more we know, the more chance we've got in catching him.
sentences.zh: 我们知道的越多，抓住他的机会就越大。

sentences.en: Leading up to the one year anniversary of Carmen's abduction,
